## Description
Briefly describe the change and its motivation or domain impact (Waste / Plant Doctor / Retrofit / Radar).

## Type of Change
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking fix for existing defect)
- [ ] Performance optimization / 3D rendering enhancement
- [ ] Python evaluation / Climate microservice expansion
- [ ] Documentation / CI workflow update

## Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] Automated test suite passes (\`npm test\` & \`npx vitest run\`)
- [ ] Next.js production build compiles with 0 errors (\`npm run build\`)
- [ ] Python evaluation benchmarks pass (\`python -m unittest eval/test_eval_suite.py\`)
- [ ] Docker container build succeeds (\`docker compose config\`)
- [ ] Verified strictly ZERO em-dashes and ZERO en-dashes
- [ ] 100% Bilingual localization preserved (id vs en)
